baseline_build.initial_archive_attempt: data-filter extraction rejected a historical absolute symlink; retried with non-build historical specs excluded
baseline_build.production_source: exact release archive; historical specifications/agent files excluded, Core execution/Store/Backend source unchanged

criteria.absolute_budget_formula: max baseline observed * 1.25 + fixed 5ms cycle/10ms including setup/25ms process
criteria.strict_work: no unrelated validity visits for unaffected selected cases; no complete unchanged-state revalidation for selected affected creation; necessary evidence output reported separately

measurements.clock_scope: total_ms is contiguous Core loop plus final evaluation; including_setup_ms adds admission/seed/create; process_wall_ms additionally includes startup and post-measurement semantic audit/reporting
measurements.failed_attempts: retain, never discard; missing/invalid/nonfinite measurements fail acceptance
measurements.os_cache: not flushed; fresh process/Store each case, warmed filesystem cache permitted
measurements.reporting_overhead: post-clock output digest/audit, process startup and teardown retained in process_wall_ms; not represented as Core validation time
measurements.timing_probe_overhead: two monotonic clocks per phase; retained records and vector pushes common to strategies; diagnostic counters compiled out in production-like binaries
measurements.variance_policy: all three repetitions must meet absolute budgets; compare medians for regression/growth; environmental mismatch requires recorded rerun, not relaxed thresholds

platform.cpu_limit: one inherited CPU for sequential measurements
platform.virtual_memory_limit: not additionally constrained; report actual process HWM
